Name: Shower Dial
Author: Felipe Drummond
Description: Your gas water heater's temperature on one key. Press once for your everyday temperature; double-press to turn the dial one notch. Works with Rinnai® heaters fitted with the Wi-Fi module, directly over your network. The key shows the live setpoint and whether water is being heated.

Actions.Name: Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the heater's setpoint. Press once to set your everyday temperature; double-press to turn the dial one notch through a range you choose. Turns the heater on first if it was off.
